name: mara-bridge
description: Measure and mix Ableton Live sets with reference comparison, spectra, EQ and compression.
long_description: Give your AI assistant ears in Ableton Live. Measure channel loudness, dynamics, stereo width and frequency masking; compare your mix with reference tracks; adjust mixer controls, EQ and compression. Requires Ableton Live 11 or 12 with Max for Live and the MARA connection installed using mara-bridge setup. Early release: tested against a Live simulator and synthetic audio; real Live workflows have not yet been verified. Parameter snapshots support restoring changes, but removed devices are not recreated.
